entities.name: András Ruják
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: András Ruják is a Hungarian professional basketball player for PVSK Panthers of the Nemzeti Bajnokság I/A. Ruják also played for the Hungarian national basketball team, as he was part of the roster that participated at EuroBasket 2017.
